# fixture: tanstack-router

Minimal placeholder fixture for testing reactlens stack detection against TanStack Router.

Used by `detectStack()` unit tests to verify `router: 'tanstack'`, `buildTool: 'vite'`. A runnable application mirroring `vite-react-router/`'s complexity is deferred to a follow-up; the AST analyzer + generator do not currently target TanStack-specific route conventions.
